name: MonarchWebhookDeliveries
title: WebhookDeliveries
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of tappable rows; androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet for the details; androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu with DropdownMenuItem and RadioButton for the status and event type filters; MonarchTextField, MonarchStatusBadge, MonarchButton, MonarchDescriptionList, MonarchSkeleton, MonarchInlineErrorRetry, MonarchEmptyState and MonarchLoadMore
summary: The delivery log of a webhook endpoint: status, event, response, attempts and time of each delivery, with filters, paging, a details sheet and Redeliver.
whenToUse: On a developer settings screen that shows what an outbound webhook or integration sent and lets the person resend a failed delivery.
whenNotToUse: For a stream of application log lines, use MonarchLogViewer. For one request's full details on its own screen, use the log-drawer recipe (a ModalBottomSheet with MonarchDescriptionList and MonarchCodeBlock).
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchWebhookDeliveries(deliveries: List<MonarchWebhookDelivery>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, statuses: MonarchStatusRegistry? = null, filterable: Boolean = true, filters: MonarchWebhookDeliveryFilters? = null, onFiltersChange: ((MonarchWebhookDeliveryFilters) -> Unit)? = null, manualFiltering: Boolean = false, filterStatuses: List<String>? = null, eventTypes: List<String> = emptyList(), showDestination: Boolean = false, counts: Map<String, Int> = emptyMap(), loading: Boolean = false, failed: Boolean = false, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, hasMore: Boolean = false, onLoadMore: (() -> Unit)? = null, loadingMore: Boolean = false, loadMoreFailed: Boolean = false, now: Long? = null, locale: Locale? = null, timeZone: String? = null, onRedeliver: (suspend (MonarchWebhookDelivery) -> Unit)? = null, canRedeliver: ((MonarchWebhookDelivery) -> Boolean)? = null, onSelect: ((MonarchWebhookDelivery) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchWebhookDeliveriesLabels = MonarchWebhookDeliveriesLabels(), emptyAction: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, actions: (@Composable RowScope.(MonarchWebhookDelivery) -> Unit)? = null, details: (@Composable ColumnScope.(MonarchWebhookDelivery) -> Unit)? = null)

options.name: deliveries
options.description: The deliveries to show, newest first. Ids must be unique.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the component. Give it a bounded height: the list is lazy.

options.name: statuses
options.description: Status names and tones over the built-in ones, or the app's own status keys.

options.name: filterable
options.description: Shows the event id search field and the status and event type menus.

options.name: filters
options.description: The filter values. null keeps them inside the component.

options.name: onFiltersChange
options.description: Called with the new filter values when the person changes one.

options.name: manualFiltering
options.description: The server filters: deliveries are shown as given; send filters with the next request.

options.name: filterStatuses
options.description: The status keys the status menu offers. null offers every key of the merged registry.

options.name: eventTypes
options.description: The event types the event type menu offers. The menu is hidden when empty.

options.name: showDestination
options.description: Shows each delivery's destination on its row.

options.name: counts
options.description: Totals per status key, shown above the list as "12 delivered · 3 retrying", in map order.

options.name: loading
options.description: The first page is loading: placeholder rows replace the list.

options.name: failed
options.description: The list failed to load: the failure replaces the list.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Called by Try again after a load failure. Without it the failure has no button.

options.name: hasMore
options.description: There is another page.

options.name: onLoadMore
options.description: Loads the next page. Adds the MonarchLoadMore footer.

options.name: loadingMore
options.description: The next page is loading.

options.name: loadMoreFailed
options.description: Loading the next page failed.

options.name: now
options.description: The time relative times are measured from, in epoch milliseconds. null follows the clock, refreshed every minute.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of numbers and dates. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: The time zone of the dates in the details sheet. An IANA id such as Europe/Berlin; null, or an id the device does not know, is the device's zone.

options.name: onRedeliver
options.description: Sends a delivery again. The button shows progress while it runs; the result is announced; throwing announces the failure. Without it there is no Redeliver.

options.name: canRedeliver
options.description: Which deliveries offer Redeliver. null offers it on every one that is not pending or sending.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Opens the app's own detail screen. null opens the built-in details sheet.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings.

options.name: emptyAction
options.description: Shown in the first-run empty state, such as a Send a test event button.

options.name: actions
options.description: More actions on each row, after Redeliver.

options.name: details
options.description: More content at the end of the details sheet, such as the request and response bodies.

states.name: loading
states.description: Four MonarchSkeleton rows replace the list, read by TalkBack as one polite "Loading deliveries".

states.name: failed
states.description: A MonarchInlineErrorRetry with "Deliveries did not load." and Try again replaces the list; without onRetry the message is danger text in a polite live region.

states.name: empty
states.description: A small first-run MonarchEmptyState, "No deliveries yet", with emptyAction.

states.name: filtered to nothing
states.description: A filtered MonarchEmptyState, "No deliveries match", with Clear filters.

states.name: filtered
states.description: The active filter's menu button becomes primary and reads "Status: Failed"; Clear filters appears next to the menus.

states.name: redelivering
states.description: The row's Redeliver (and the sheet's) shows progress and is read as Loading until onRedeliver returns.

states.name: scheduled retry
states.description: A pending or retrying delivery with nextAttemptMillis shows "Next attempt in 10 minutes" in place of the last attempt's time.

states.name: not attempted
states.description: A delivery with no attempts and no response shows "Not attempted yet".

states.name: more pages
states.description: With onLoadMore, a MonarchLoadMore footer ends the list: Load more, loading, a failure with Retry, or "End of the delivery log".

appearance: A plain list on the surface color with subtle dividers. The event type uses the strong body style in the default text color, the event id the code style; time, response and attempts use the caption style in the muted text color, and an error the strong danger color. Status badges use their tone's subtle fill. The same roles adapt to dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: A domain composite, marked experimental until a Rook app adopts it. The web shows a table with a column per fact; on a phone each delivery is a row of stacked lines and its full details open in a ModalBottomSheet (or the app's own screen through onSelect), the list-and-detail pattern people expect on Android. The copy button of the event id moved into the sheet, where MonarchDescriptionList copies it. The web's status, event type and search filters are a MonarchTextField and two menu buttons that open DropdownMenus with radio items. onRedeliver is a suspend function instead of a returned promise; error is a failed flag with a built-in, overridable message instead of rich content; destination and error are strings. Status icons are not shown because Monarch bundles no icons; the status is always written. There is no iOS entry yet.
accessibility: Each row is one TalkBack element read as status, time, event type, event id, response and attempts, and error; its action is named "View delivery of invoice.paid evt_1".
Redeliver is a separate element named after the event it resends, such as "Redeliver invoice.paid evt_1", and is read as Loading while it runs.
A queued or failed redelivery is announced through a polite live region that is always present.
The counts line is a polite live region, so new totals are read.
Filter menu items are radio buttons marked selected for the current value.
Statuses and errors are words, so nothing relies on color.
Redeliver and the filter buttons have 48dp touch targets.
edgeCases: The search matches the event id exactly, ignoring case, or any part of the event type; blank text is no filter.
Status keys that are neither built in nor in statuses are shown with the key as their name.
The list is lazy: give it a bounded height. Inside a vertically scrolling parent it would get an infinite height and fail.
A delivery that disappears from deliveries while its sheet is open closes the sheet.
Long event types and errors wrap; nothing is cut at font scale 2.0.
Redeliver is ignored while the same delivery is already being redelivered.

examples.title: Delivery log with redeliver
examples.template:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchWebhookDeliveries(
    deliveries = listOf(
        MonarchWebhookDelivery(id = {{deliveries.0.id}}, status = {{deliveries.0.status}}, eventType = {{deliveries.0.eventType}}, attempts = {{deliveries.0.attempts}}, atMillis = now - {{deliveries.0.ageSeconds}} * 1_000L, eventId = {{deliveries.0.eventId}}, responseCode = {{deliveries.0.responseCode}}, durationMillis = {{deliveries.0.durationMs}}),
        MonarchWebhookDelivery(id = {{deliveries.1.id}}, status = {{deliveries.1.status}}, eventType = {{deliveries.1.eventType}}, attempts = {{deliveries.1.attempts}}, atMillis = now - {{deliveries.1.ageSeconds}} * 1_000L, eventId = {{deliveries.1.eventId}}, responseCode = {{deliveries.1.responseCode}}, error = {{deliveries.1.error}}, nextAttemptMillis = now + {{deliveries.1.nextAttemptSeconds}} * 1_000L),
        MonarchWebhookDelivery(id = {{deliveries.2.id}}, status = {{deliveries.2.status}}, eventType = {{deliveries.2.eventType}}, attempts = {{deliveries.2.attempts}}, atMillis = now - {{deliveries.2.ageSeconds}} * 1_000L, eventId = {{deliveries.2.eventId}}, error = {{deliveries.2.error}}),
        MonarchWebhookDelivery(id = {{deliveries.3.id}}, status = {{deliveries.3.status}}, eventType = {{deliveries.3.eventType}}, attempts = {{deliveries.3.attempts}}, atMillis = now - {{deliveries.3.ageSeconds}} * 1_000L, eventId = {{deliveries.3.eventId}}),
    ),
    modifier = Modifier.height(1280.dp),
    eventTypes = listOf({{eventTypes.0}}, {{eventTypes.1}}, {{eventTypes.2}}),
    now = now,
    onRedeliver = { },
)

@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchWebhookDeliveries(
    deliveries = listOf(
        MonarchWebhookDelivery(id = "d1", status = "succeeded", eventType = "order.created", attempts = 1, atMillis = now - 120 * 1_000L, eventId = "evt_3c91a0", responseCode = 200, durationMillis = 142),
        MonarchWebhookDelivery(id = "d2", status = "retrying", eventType = "order.updated", attempts = 2, atMillis = now - 540 * 1_000L, eventId = "evt_3c8f12", responseCode = 503, error = "The endpoint answered 503", nextAttemptMillis = now + 300 * 1_000L),
        MonarchWebhookDelivery(id = "d3", status = "failed", eventType = "invoice.paid", attempts = 6, atMillis = now - 3900 * 1_000L, eventId = "evt_3c7b55", error = "No response within 10 seconds"),
        MonarchWebhookDelivery(id = "d4", status = "pending", eventType = "order.created", attempts = 0, atMillis = now - 30 * 1_000L, eventId = "evt_3c9d77"),
    ),
    modifier = Modifier.height(1280.dp),
    eventTypes = listOf("order.created", "order.updated", "invoice.paid"),
    now = now,
    onRedeliver = { },
)

examples.title: Server-side filters and paging
examples.setup:
var filters by remember { mutableStateOf(MonarchWebhookDeliveryFilters()) }
var page by remember { mutableStateOf(listOf<MonarchWebhookDelivery>()) }
examples.code:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchWebhookDeliveries(
    deliveries = page,
    modifier = Modifier.height(480.dp),
    filters = filters,
    onFiltersChange = { filters = it /* The app fetches the first page with these filters. */ },
    manualFiltering = true,
    hasMore = true,
    onLoadMore = { /* The app fetches the next page with the cursor it holds. */ },
    onSelect = { /* The app opens its own delivery screen. */ },
)

parityExceptions.reason: The web shows a table with filters and a Redeliver button in each row; on a phone each delivery is a row that opens a details sheet where Redeliver and the copy action live, and the filters are menus.
parityExceptions.convention: Material 3 list-detail: a row opens a ModalBottomSheet
